Real Dreams, Fake Opportunities (2022)

The OSCE in Kosovo entrusted us with the creation of two impactful videos for the Ministry of Internal Affairs, aimed at raising awareness about the harsh realities of human trafficking. Each screenplay was crafted with thoughtful precision, drawing from real-life situations that resonate deeply within Kosovo's own landscape, ensuring an authentic and meaningful portrayal.
